name: firefighter

accessories.name: Firefighter helmet
accessories.description: Big bright yellow firefighter helmet with a wide rounded dome, a long back brim that flares out, a raised front ridge and a red shield badge on the front

accessories.name: Reflective stripes
accessories.description: Two wide silver-white reflective bands wrapped around the red coat at chest and waist, with a yellow strip down the front

accessories.name: Fire axe

accessories.name: Air tank
accessories.description: Grey and yellow breathing air tank cylinder strapped to the back
